document_id: City of Medicine Hat - LMS tender

evidence.quote: Submission Deadline: May 28, 2026 2:00 PM local time
Deadline for Questions May 21, 2026 4:00 PM local time
For the purposes of this invitation, the RFP Contact is: Joanne Bruneau-Carter, joabru@medicinehat.ca
Proposals must be submitted to the City’s online bidding system portal at: https://medicinehat.bidsandtenders.ca/Module

The term of the agreement is to be for a period of five (5) years, with an option in favour of the City to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions annually for an additional two (2) years.

value.summary: Provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) available 24/7 supporting approximately 1,500 employees, volunteers, and external learners across City departments for corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking.
key_deliverables: Centralize learning delivery and records (including compliance-related training)
Support blended learning (self-paced eLearning, virtual instructor-led, and classroom)
Course development platform supporting SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI (Tin Can), video, PDF, and web content
Robust analytics, dashboards, and compliance reporting with API-based data access
Integration with Microsoft 365 (Azure AD SSO, Teams, SharePoint) and Unit4 ERP/HRIS/Finance
External user management for temporary staff, volunteers, contractors, and external agencies
Data migration of users and organization hierarchy with mapping templates
Admin, instructor, manager, and learner training with editable materials
System integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT)
Cutover plan, rollback criteria, and hypercare support for at least 30 days post go-live
24/7 customer support with defined SLAs and 99.9% uptime

evidence.quote: The City of Medicine Hat (“the City”) is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.
